title.en: CHILDREN AND YOUNG PERSONS APPROVED SCHOOLS AND APPROVED HOMES REGULATIONS 2010

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-36-2010-CHILDREN-AND-YOUNG-PERSONS-APPROVED-SCHOOLS-AND-APPROVED-HOMES-REGULATIONS-2010.pdf》（2 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Children and Young Persons (Approved Schools and Approved Homes) Order, 2010 and shall commence on the same date as the Children and Young Persons Order, 2006. Approved schools and approved homes.

The following approved schools and approved homes are hereby established for the purposes of the Order - {a) Darussyafaah Puteri, Kompleks Rumah Kebajikan Belimbing, Simpang 421, Jalan Subok, Bandar Seri Begawan; {b) Darussyafaah Putera, Kompleks Rumah Kebajikan Belimbing, Simpang 421, Jalan Subok, Bandar Seri Begawan. Made this 11th. day of Rabiulawal, 1431 Hijriah corresponding to the 25th. day of February, 2010.

PEHIN ORANG KAY A SETIA PAHLA WAN DATO SERI SETIA DR. A WANG HAJI AHMAD BIN HAJI JUMAT Minister of Culture, Youth and Sports, Brunei Darussalam.
